{"sql": "WITH female_with_salary AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    a.account_id,
    d.a11 as avg_salary
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
  JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
)
SELECT 
  f1.account_id,
  (
    SELECT MAX(f2.avg_salary)
    FROM female_with_salary f2
  ) - (
    SELECT MIN(f3.avg_salary)
    FROM female_with_salary f3
    WHERE f3.birth_date = (
      SELECT MIN(f4.birth_date)
      FROM female_with_salary f4
    )
  ) AS salary_gap
FROM female_with_salary f1
WHERE f1.birth_date = (
  SELECT MIN(f5.birth_date)
  FROM female_with_salary f5
)
AND f1.avg_salary = (
  SELECT MIN(f6.avg_salary)
  FROM female_with_salary f6
  WHERE f6.birth_date = (
    SELECT MIN(f7.birth_date)
    FROM female_with_salary f7
  )
);"}

  LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
  SELECT t.balance as bal_start
  FROM trans t
  JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
  WHERE t.date <= '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY t.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
  SELECT t.balance as bal_end
  FROM trans t
  JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
  WHERE t.date <= '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY t.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

FROM balance_start, balance_end"}

{"sql": "WITH cte_2013_czk AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customerid,
    c.segment,
    AVG(y.consumption) as annual_avg_consumption,
    SUM(y.consumption) as total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.customerid = c.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    annual_avg_consumption,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
  FROM cte_2013_czk
),
segment_data AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    annual_avg_consumption
  FROM min_consumption_per_segment
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) - 
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) as difference_sme_lam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) - 
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) as difference_lam_kam,
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) - 
  MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) as difference_kam_sme
FROM segment_data"}

{"sql": "WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    customers.segment,
    SUBSTRING(yearmonth.date, 1, 4) AS year,
    SUM(yearmonth.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth
  JOIN customers ON yearmonth.customerid = customers.customerid
  WHERE customers.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY customers.segment, SUBSTRING(yearmonth.date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT
  yearly_consumption.segment,
  ((MAX(CASE WHEN yearly_consumption.year = '2013' THEN yearly_consumption.total_consumption END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN yearly_consumption.year = '2012' THEN yearly_consumption.total_consumption END)) /
   NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN yearly_consumption.year = '2012' THEN yearly_consumption.total_consumption END), 0)) * 100 AS pct_increase
FROM yearly_consumption
GROUP BY yearly_consumption.segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC"}

  SELECT transactions_1k.customerid
  FROM transactions_1k

),
consumption_2012 AS (
  SELECT customer_match.customerid, SUM(yearmonth.consumption) as total_2012
  FROM customer_match
  JOIN yearmonth ON customer_match.customerid = yearmonth.customerid
  WHERE yearmonth.date >= '201201' AND yearmonth.date <= '201212'
  GROUP BY customer_match.customerid
),
consumption_2013 AS (
  SELECT customer_match.customerid, SUM(yearmonth.consumption) as total_2013
  FROM customer_match
  JOIN yearmonth ON customer_match.customerid = yearmonth.customerid
  WHERE yearmonth.date >= '201301' AND yearmonth.date <= '201312'
  GROUP BY customer_match.customerid
)

{"sql": "WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cards.istextless = 1) AS textless_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE cards.isstoryspotlight = 1
),
textless_cards AS (
  SELECT cards.id
  FROM cards
  WHERE cards.isstoryspotlight = 1 AND cards.istextless = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * stats.textless_count / NULLIF(stats.total_count, 0), 2) AS percentage,
  textless_cards.id
FROM stats
CROSS JOIN textless_cards
ORDER BY textless_cards.id"}

{"sql": "WITH banned_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    legalities.format,
    COUNT(*) as banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE legalities.status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY legalities.format
)
SELECT 
  banned_by_format.format,
  cards.name
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
JOIN banned_by_format ON legalities.format = banned_by_format.format
WHERE legalities.status = 'Banned'
  AND banned_by_format.banned_count = (SELECT MAX(banned_count) FROM banned_by_format)
ORDER BY cards.name;"}
